description: cube one OpenCode configuration: managed settings, company rules, plugins and personal configuration seeds
notes: Close OpenCode Desktop AND its server before installing or updating this configuration.
The managed configuration lives in C:\ProgramData\opencode and is read-only for everyone except Administrators and SYSTEM. A required managed update must succeed or installation fails.

Put the keys in HKLM\SOFTWARE\cubeone\OpenCode. OpenRouterApiKey is for models and everything else. OpenRouterVoiceApiKey is only for dictation. Neither value is part of this package. Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_FREE_MODELS=1, then restart OpenCode.
Personal files in ~\.config\opencode are retained. No SSH or WSL setup runs automatically. Uninstalling or updating this package never removes C:\ProgramData\opencode.

script: throw "cube one OpenCode configuration failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
